purpose: Teach: 亀裂/覚せい/熱烈/サリン/加速度/臨界/培養/入管

lines.speaker: saito_doctor
lines.jp: 蓮さん、医療チーム内の亀裂を起こさないよう、医療チームで対話を重ねます
lines.en: Ren — we work through these conversations as a team to keep rifts from forming within the medical department.
lines.style: Steady, measured delivery. Clear professional tone without coldness. Each phrase lands with quiet certainty. The voice of someone who has thought through this carefully and is offering both reassurance and accountability.

lines.speaker: saito_doctor
lines.jp: はい、覚せい剤中毒の治療を医療チームで担当します
lines.en: Yes, we handle stimulant addiction treatment as a coordinated medical team.
lines.style: Even, professional tone. No pause for emphasis — just factual clarity. The confidence of someone describing established practice. Slight warmth underneath the clinical register.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 熱烈な希望者への治験を、貴院、ご対応されてるそうですね、先生
lines.en: I understand your hospital is taking on clinical trials with highly motivated volunteers, Doctor.
lines.style: Careful, thoughtful phrasing. Slight hesitation before speaking — gathering his thoughts. Respectful distance. The tone of someone asking to understand something, not perform knowledge.

lines.speaker: saito_doctor
lines.jp: はい、サリン中毒の救護研究を医療チームで参照します
lines.en: Yes, we reference our research team's work on treatment protocols for chemical exposure cases.
lines.style: Composed and direct. Clinical in register but not remote. Each statement delivered as fact without elaboration. The professional ease of someone discussing her own department's work.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 加速度の急変による怪我対応を、貴院、なさってますね、先生
lines.en: So your hospital does handle acute injury response from sudden acceleration trauma, then.
lines.style: Quiet observation rather than question. Gentle uptick at the end — genuine curiosity, not interrogation. The tone of someone confirming what he's pieced together, with respect for her expertise.

lines.speaker: saito_doctor
lines.jp: はい、臨界量を超えた被ばく対応の準備を医療チームで進めます
lines.en: Yes, we're preparing protocols for managing radiation exposure cases within the medical team's scope.
lines.style: Clear and steady. Professional distance maintained. No softening or extra breath — just fact delivered with the quiet authority of someone who knows what her team can handle.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 培養技術を用いた再生医療を、貴院、ご研究中なんですね、先生
lines.en: Your hospital is doing research into regenerative medicine using tissue culture techniques, I gather.
lines.style: Soft opening. Reflective, almost musing tone — as if he's fitting pieces together. Respectful of expertise without deference. A small lift at the end, inviting confirmation rather than demanding it.

lines.speaker: saito_doctor
lines.jp: はい、入管経由の海外患者対応も医療チームで行います
lines.en: Yes, we also manage care for international patients referred through immigration channels as part of our team's work.
lines.style: Steady, level delivery. Professional warmth — not distant, but appropriately boundaried. Slight softening on the opening word. The voice of someone acknowledging a responsibility and stating it plainly.
